title: 🚨 The easiest way to spot a FALSE PROPHET… is to see who PROFITS. 💸🔥
paragraphs:
🚨 The easiest way to spot a FALSE PROPHET… is to see who PROFITS. 💸🔥
😂✨ When “faith” starts needing a receipt, maybe it’s time to check who’s really being saved — your soul or their bank account.

🎤 “False Prophet$ — A Divine Comedy”
A hilarious look at modern miracles, marketing, and money.
🎬 Because sometimes the sermon sounds more like a sales pitch.

📖 Bible Verse:
“Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing but inwardly are ravenous wolves.”
— Matthew 7:15 (KJV)
